name: com.get-flowie/website
title: Flowie
description: Ask about Flowie: invoicing in 150 countries via Sovos, order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, SRM.

tools.name: search_flowie
tools.description: Search the public get-flowie.com content (platform, solutions, e-invoicing, integrations, pricing, blog, glossary) and return the most relevant pages with title, URL, and a snippet. Use this first to find which pages answer a question about Flowie's product, compliance coverage, integrations, or pricing.

query.description: Natural-language search query, e.g. 'France e-invoicing mandate' or 'SAP integration'.

tools.name: fetch_flowie_page
tools.description: Return the clean Markdown of a single get-flowie.com page. Pass a path like '/platform/ai-agents' or '/e-invoicing/france' (or a full https://get-flowie.com/... URL). Use after search_flowie to read a page's full content cheaply.

path.description: Page path or full URL, e.g. '/pricing' or 'https://get-flowie.com/platform/intake-to-pay'.

tools.name: get_flowie_overview
tools.description: Return a canonical, citable summary of what Flowie is — positioning, key capabilities, compliance coverage, pricing model, and the most useful entry-point URLs. Takes no arguments. Use when asked 'what is Flowie' or for a grounded company/product overview.
